{{#SQuote:|text=Certain actions can disturb the infection and provoke retaliation. Dislodgment triggers can activate from interaction, recovery, or parasite activity, escalating responses through multiple tiers of strength.|speaker=[[Compendium|The Compendium]]|receiver=|attribution=|source=|id=something|template=}}

'''Dislodgment''' is a [[Systems|System]] added in [[Version 1.10.0]] that allows parasites to retaliate against interaction with and removal of their territory.

==''Info''==
Dislodgment applies certain buffs to Parasites and debuffs on non-Parasites, all based on RNG and the player's actions. In turn for the benefits, each event consumes a set amount of [[Evolution Phases|Evolution Points]] and sets a cooldown to the code that was activated. Not all codes will be available in all Phases. It is unlocked at [[Ubiquitous Development]] Level 1. As of now there are 19 Triggers combined with 26 available Dislodgment Codes and Effects.

Almost all aspects of Dislodgment can be monitored in detail with the [[Module Reports#Dislodgement Report|Dislodgment Report]], obtained by scanning the [[Modules#Dislodgement Module|Dislodgment Module]] in the [[Relay Tower]], such as code effects, duration, and value.

== Codes and Effects ==
''IMPORTANT: CODE LEVELS ARE RANDOMLY CHOSEN'' 

=== Code 0 ===
* COTH effect will ignore amplifier value and will trigger itself at max level.
** Can be activated by Triggers #1, #10, #14, #16;
** Costs 100 Evolution Points;
** Lasts for 60 seconds;
** Adds a Code cooldown of 240 seconds.
*** Code Value is not important.
* Sound File: N/A

=== Code 1 ===
* Spawns Parasites based on its level.
** Can be activated by Triggers #12, #13, #14, #15, #16;
** Costs 200 Evolution Points;
** Lasts for 40 seconds;
** Adds a Code cooldown of 240 seconds.
*** Level 1 - Spawns Feral Parasites and needs 1 point;
*** Level 2 - Spawns Primitive Parasites and needs 9 points;
*** Level 3 - Spawns Adapted Parasites and needs 15 points;
*** Level 4 - Spawns Pure Parasites and needs 21 points.
* Sound File:
[[File:Dislo 1.ogg]]

=== Code 2 ===
* Killing parasites will spawn stronger ones.
** Can be activated by Triggers #10, #15, #16;
** Costs 200 Evolution Points;
** Lasts for 60 seconds;
** Adds a Code cooldown of 200 seconds.
** Killing a Parasite will add 5 points to the Code Level.
*** Will start with 1 point.
*** Code value are deaths required.
*** Will spawn: [[Assimilated Enderman]] when point value is 1, [[Feral Enderman]] when point value is 50, and [[Warden]] when point value is 100.
* Sound File:
[[File:Dislo 2.ogg]]

=== Code 3 ===
* Parasites will be able to spawn with potion effects.
** Can be activated by Triggers #4, #13, #14, #15, #16;
** Costs 300 Evolution Points;
** Lasts for 120 seconds;
** Adds a Code cooldown of 200 seconds.
*** Will start with 1 point.
*** Code value is used as amplifier for the effect.
*** The following effects can be received: Invisibility, Fire Resistance, Speed.
* Sound File:
[[File:Dislo 3.ogg]]

=== Code 4 ===
* Parasites will be able to spawn with more health/damage/armor.
** Can be activated by Triggers #4, #13, #14, #15, #16;
** Costs 1000 Evolution Points;
** Lasts for 60 seconds;
** Adds a Code cooldown of 300 seconds.
*** Code value is used as multiplier.
*** Will start with 2 points.
* Sound File:
[[File:Dislo 4.ogg]]
